threat_summary: A malware report describes hidden PowerShell launched from a script host, using encoded commands to download a payload and run it from a user temp folder.
key_behaviors: payload is written under user temp path
hunt_checklist: Search for encoded PowerShell command lines.
Filter PowerShell launched by script hosts or Office apps.
Check outbound connections after the process starts.
Review downloaded file paths and hashes.
correlation_logic: Correlate behavior on the same host/user within a 24-hour window unless the report specifies a narrower time range.
escalation_condition: Escalate when encoded PowerShell has outbound traffic or writes executable content.
analyst_notes: Generated as synthetic gold output for MVP evaluation. Queries should be reviewed against the real SIEM/EDR schema.
